messages.subject: GUI
parts:
Hi Chris,
I wanted to ask you about the GUI. Is it only for tractography and fMRI or it can also be used for structural covariance networks (Chapter 6)?

Because in the manual (4.1.5 Visualize Results) you write: There is a GUI for quick manipulation and inspection of graphs, as well as several functions for plotting results from specific analyses.

messages.author: dadcb4fd6a01f8d1
messages.subject: Re: [brainGraph-help] GUI
parts:
Yes, it can be used for structural covariance networks. The way it is worded in the User Guide is admittedly unclear, and the portion you highlighted should probably be written elsewhere.

Chris
